name: Tumor
overview: The biblical references to tumors, specifically described as 'emerods' in 1 Samuel 5 and 6, portray them as a divine judgment inflicted upon the Philistines for their treatment of the Ark of the Covenant. These morbid swellings caused widespread suffering among the people and their leaders, prompting them to acknowledge the power of the God of Israel through offerings made of golden images representing the tumors and mice. This account underscores God's sovereignty in using physical affliction as a means to bring about repentance and glory to Himself.
